title: Warp warehouse vision manifest
description: Output of your pipeline over a data split. One entry per image. Grade it with: python grade.py manifest.json

file.description: Image filename exactly as it appears in data/dev/images, e.g. tote_0001.jpg

items.description: One entry per item your pipeline detected in the tote. Empty array if the tote is empty.

bbox.description: [x, y, width, height] in pixels, origin top-left

action.description: pick = the robot should attempt the pick you propose. flag = send this tote to a human instead.

pick.description: Required when action is pick. The suction target, in pixels on the image.

item_index.description: Optional index into items for the item you chose to pick

reason.description: One short sentence: why this item first, or why you flagged the tote.

confidence.description: Optional overall confidence for this image, 0 to 1
